title: How to Plan a Ghost Mannequin Photo Workflow Without Photoshop
description: Plan a practical ghost mannequin workflow, understand what background removal can and cannot do, and prepare clothing images for careful compositing.

blocks.text: Ever wonder why high-end clothing brands' product photos look like the shirt is being worn by an invisible person? That's the ghost mannequin effect. And it makes garments look more structured and premium than flat lays.
Here's how to fake it without hiring a $200/hour retoucher.

Pro Tips for Clothing Photos
Use a clear or thin hanger. Wire hangers photograph well because their thin lines are easy for AI to remove cleanly.
Steam or iron everything. Wrinkles distract buyers and hurt the premium feel. No editing tool fixes wrinkles properly.
Shoot straight on, eye level. Angled shots make garments look weird. Symmetric front-facing = professional.
Include detail shots. Fabric texture, stitching, buttons, tags—3-5 macro shots per listing.
Handling Complex Fabrics
The local model attempts to preserve fine edges, but chains, lace, mesh, and reflective details are difficult cases. Inspect the result at high zoom and use manual edge refinement when needed.
Solid opaque fabric is trivial. Even fringe and tassels work.
